description: This Java source file defines the class LocalRepoManager, which manages local F-Droid repositories, including generating index files, handling web assets, and signing repositories.

classes.name: LocalRepoManager
classes.description: Manages local F-Droid repositories, including index generation, asset handling, and signing.

methods.name: LocalRepoManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing directories, assets, and files for repository management.

methods.description: Copies or symlinks the F-Droid APK into the webroot and returns its URL.

methods.name: writeIndexPage
methods.description: Generates the index.html page with app list and assets.

methods.name: attemptToMkdir
methods.description: Creates directory if it does not exist, throws if a file exists with same name.

methods.name: symlinkFileElsewhere

methods.name: getIndexJar

methods.name: getWebRoot

methods.name: deleteRepo
methods.description: Deletes all contents of the repository directory.

methods.description: Generates a new repository index, updates app list, and signs the index jar.

methods.name: cacheApps
methods.description: Caches app information from the generated index.

methods.name: writeIndexJar
